# End Point Dev

> > End Point Dev provides software development, consulting, and technical services including secure messaging tools, database expertise (PostgreSQL), and technology training.

End Point Dev is a technology consulting company offering custom development, infrastructure support, and specialized tools like d-note (self-destructing encrypted notes). The site features technical blog posts covering databases, development practices, and business growth strategies.

## Key Topics

- End Point Dev
- PostgreSQL
- Python
- JavaScript
- Self-destructing notes
- d-note encryption
- AES-256 security
- Database consulting
- VisionPort
- On-site training
- Technical support
- Software development
- Client acquisition
- Business development
- Secure messaging

## Core Services & Tools

- [End Point Dev Self Destructing Notes](https://secrets.endpointdev.com): Secure self-destructing encrypted message sharing tool by End Point Dev
- [About d-note - Self Destructing Notes](https://secrets.endpointdev.com/about): About d-note: open source Flask app for self-destructing encrypted messages
- [On-site Training and Support](https://endpointdev.com/expertise/training-support): On-site training & support for VisionPort, databases, Linux, Windows, & more

## Technical Blog & Resources

- [Client Mining: Growing Your Business Through Acquisition and Relationships](https://endpointdev.com/blog/2025/05/client-mining): Business development guide: client acquisition & relationship management
- [Postgres 9.5: three little things](https://endpointdev.com/blog/2016/01/postgres-95-three-little-things): Postgres 9.5 features: REINDEX VERBOSE, schema reindex, & pg_ctl improvements
- [To ask or not to ask? Debug first.](https://endpointdev.com/blog/2013/02/to-ask-or-not-to-ask-debug-first): Developer advice: when to ask for help & debugging best practices
